page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.6xlarge is a high-clock-speed, memory-dense virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 24 dedicated virtual CPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include dedicated graphics accelerators, operating with zero GPUs.

Storage and networking configurations require reliance on external block devices and virtual networking fabric. The instance includes no local ephemeral storage, meaning all persistent data and operating system installations must utilize remote block storage volumes. Network connectivity is rated at an 18 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating consistent data transmission between connected services. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the instance allocation.

The 1:8 compute-to-memory configuration combined with dedicated 3.4 GHz clock speeds targets workloads constrained by single-thread frequency and system memory capacity. Without bundled local disk resources, cost efficiency depends on provisioning appropriate networked storage to match the compute profile. Primary workload fits include in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise cache tiers, high-throughput financial modeling, electronic design automation (EDA), and heavy data analytics pipelines requiring significant memory per core.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.6xlarge is a dedicated KVM-based virtual server belonging to the high-clock-speed instance family. It is equipped with 24 dedicated vCPUs on the Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.4 GHz, paired with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core allocation. The instance features no integrated GPU hardware and provides no local disk storage, necessitating network-attached block volumes for system and runtime data. Network throughput operates at a baseline of 18 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned. Given the high CPU clock speed and substantial RAM volume, the instance is structured for memory-intensive enterprise tasks such as distributed in-memory data grids, large relational and NoSQL databases, electronic design automation, batch financial processing, and memory-constrained analytical workloads requiring strong single-thread execution.
